$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editors. Ignored by pubreform.

schedule.description: When the range of update target versions moves forward.

cron.description: Cron expression with 5 fields (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week), evaluated in `timezone`.

min_release_age_days.description: Only versions published at least this many days before the schedule time are used.

labels.description: Labels added to pull requests. Missing labels are created.

versioning.description: Whether the minor and patch group also raises lower bounds in pubspec.yaml (`increase`) or only updates pubspec.lock (`lockfile-only`). Pinned versions are rewritten either way.

versions.description: Versions to skip, in pub version constraint syntax (for example `>=3.0.0` or `^2.0.0`). If omitted, all updates of the package are skipped.

post_update.description: Commands run, in order, before each pull request is created or regenerated. Files they change are committed with the update. Linux runners only.

run.description: Command run with `sh -c` in a Docker container, in a copy of the repository without `.git`.

network.description: Whether the command can use the network.

env.description: Names of more environment variables to pass to the command, with their values in the workflow. Names starting with `INPUT_` or `ACTIONS_` are not allowed.
